The net Bayesian update yields a 79% probability of bankruptcy before May 1, 2026, with calibration reflecting both strong distress signals and strong mitigants, and some sector-wide uncertainty.
summary: Forecasters flag Frontier as distressed based on Altman Z-score (<1.8) in the ULCC reference class, supporting a high bankruptcy risk posture.
Near-term mitigants (substantial liquidity, and no debt maturities until 2027) plus an expected Verizon acquisition close in early 2026 materially reduce near-term bankruptcy risk.
Industry dynamics (Spirit Airlines' bankruptcy context) add some upward pressure, introducing sector-wide risk signals.
Overall, a Bayesian update yields a posterior probability of 0.79 for bankruptcy before May 1, 2026, acknowledging substantial uncertainty due to model dispersion.
